title: ADL Lift Services Limited — claimed by auditteam
description: GB · Manufacturing · ADL Lift Services Limited is a Scotland-based commercial lift specialist, incorporated in 2010 and now headquartered in Bellshill at Strathclyde Business Park, that under the leadership of Brian Harkin employs around 40 people with assets and shareholders’ funds in the low-millions-of-pounds range, focuses on Glasgow and other major Scottish cities while offering UK-wide 24-hour emergency call-out
